head.title: How a client team is set up
head.lead: Five steps from the first call to a team that runs your month end on its own.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: We review your chart of accounts, close calendar and the files each team member touches, and agree what moves first.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: Process mapping
steps.text: Each task is written up as a checklist with owners, cut-off times and the reviewer who signs it off.

steps.label: Weeks 3-4
steps.title: Team setup
steps.text: Accountants are selected for your software and sector, then trained on your files with a senior reviewer beside them.

steps.label: Month 2
steps.title: Parallel run
steps.text: Our team closes one month alongside yours. Every difference is traced and the checklists are corrected.

steps.label: Month 3
steps.title: Steady state
steps.text: The team runs the close on its own, with a weekly status note and a monthly review of accuracy and timing.
